changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO field_configuration (id, field_name, field_type, work_order_request_configuration_id) SELECT nextval('field_configuration_seq'), f.field_name, 0, c.id FROM work_order_request_configuration c CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('estimatedStartDate'), ('estimatedDuration')) AS f(field_name) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM field_configuration fc WHERE fc.work_order_request_configuration_id = c.id AND fc.field_name = f.field_name);
